executiveSummary.summary: Navigation security validation reveals CRITICAL gaps. No ProtectedRoute component exists. Every protected route (customer dashboard, admin panel, training admin) is accessible without authentication. Role-based content gating exists only in the enterprise workspace shell via WorkspacePage.canView(), which shows a placeholder rather than redirecting. The default role is 'administrator', granting full access by default. The application is NOT safe for production deployment from a navigation security standpoint.

details.evidence: Searched entire codebase for: ProtectedRoute, RequireAuth, AuthGuard, PrivateRoute, AuthenticatedRoute. None found.
details.impact: Every route in the application can be accessed by typing the URL directly, regardless of authentication status.
details.risk: Unauthenticated users can access customer dashboards, admin panels, order management, financial data, customer PII, and system configuration.

routeGuardValidation.recommendation: Implement a <ProtectedRoute> component that checks authentication state and redirects to /login if unauthenticated. Wrap all protected routes with this component.

navigationGuardValidation.finding: CRITICAL — Navigation guards exist ONLY in sidebar filtering, not at route level

details.adminSidebarFiltering: Works — getFilteredSidebarItems() filters by admin role
details.routeLevelGuards: MISSING — No React Router guards on any route
details.workspacePageRoleCheck: PRESENT BUT INSUFFICIENT — WorkspacePage.tsx line 25 checks canView() but only renders a placeholder panel, does NOT redirect or block rendering
details.bypassRisk: Any user can type any URL in the browser and see the page (or a placeholder) — sidebar filtering is purely cosmetic

navigationGuardValidation.recommendation: Implement route-level navigation guards with actual redirect behavior (Navigate to /access-denied or /login). Replace placeholder-only role checks with proper blocking + redirect.

browserHistoryValidation.finding: HIGH — Browser history is fully managed by React Router with no session-aware history management

details.historyAfterLogout: NO PROTECTION — No history clearing on logout
details.historyAfterTimeout: NO PROTECTION — No history clearing on session timeout
details.protectedPageLeakage: POSSIBLE — Back/forward can navigate to previously accessed protected pages after logout
details.sessionStorage: last_admin_page saved but no clearing mechanism on logout

browserHistoryValidation.recommendation: Implement history.replace() with /login on logout. Clear sessionStorage entries on logout and session expiry.

redirectValidation.finding: HIGH — Redirect logic is limited and not enforced for unauthorized access

details.logoutRedirect: PARTIAL — /session-expired exists but no programmatic logout flow
details.expiredSessionRedirect: Present — Session state 'expired' renders SessionExpired with 'Sign in again' link to /login
details.unauthorizedRedirect: PARTIAL — WorkspacePage shows placeholder but does NOT redirect
details.404Handling: Present — Two NotFound routes (line 754 and line 843)
details.500Handling: MISSING — No global error boundary with redirect
details.fallbackRouting: Present — Catch-all routes in both route groups

redirectValidation.recommendation: Add automatic redirect to /login when WorkspacePage.canView() returns false. Add global error boundary with redirect for 500-level errors.

deepLinkValidation.finding: CRITICAL — Deep links bypass all protection

details.checkout: ACCESSIBLE — /checkout is publicly defined in navigation.ts
details.specificOrder: ACCESSIBLE — /dashboard/orders/:id can be typed directly, no guard
details.specificProfile: ACCESSIBLE — /dashboard/profile can be typed directly, no guard
details.trainingPages: ACCESSIBLE — /admin/training/* can be typed directly, no guard
details.adminPages: ACCESSIBLE — /admin/* can be typed directly, no guard
details.analyticsPages: ACCESSIBLE — /dashboard/analytics can be typed directly, no guard
details.reports: ACCESSIBLE — /admin/reports can be typed directly, no guard
details.customerData: ACCESSIBLE — /admin/customers can be typed directly, no guard
details.financialData: ACCESSIBLE — /admin/finance can be typed directly, no guard

deepLinkValidation.evidence: All routes are defined in App.tsx <Routes> without any guard wrappers. Deep linking directly to these URLs renders the full component.
deepLinkValidation.recommendation: Wrap ALL protected routes with a <ProtectedRoute> component. Verify role before rendering any protected content. Redirect to /access-denied on role mismatch.

urlManipulationValidation.finding: MEDIUM — URL parameter manipulation is not validated at route level

details.parameterTampering: No validation — Dynamic params like :id are not validated
details.sqlStrings: Partially handled by React Router (URL encoding) but no server-side validation
details.scriptInjection: Partially handled — React escapes XSS in rendering but route params are not sanitized
details.queryStringModification: No validation — Query strings are not validated
details.hashFragments: No validation — Hash fragments are ignored by React Router

urlManipulationValidation.recommendation: Add parameter validation (parseInt with NaN checks for :id params). Add route-level validation for required parameters. Implement 404 redirect for invalid parameters.

details.sessionCheckOnRoute: MISSING — No route checks if user is authenticated
details.expiredSessionHandling: PRESENT but disconnected — useSession() hook tracks idle timers but does not integrate with routing
details.authRedirectOnExpiry: PARTIAL — Session component shows 'Sign in again' but does NOT automatically redirect
details.defaultRoleIsAdmin: CRITICAL — useState<Role>('administrator') means full access by default, no auth check

sessionAwareRoutingValidation.recommendation: Integrate session state with route guards. Add middleware-level session validation. Change default role to 'guest' and require actual authentication. Automatically redirect to /session-expired on timeout.

protectedComponentValidation.finding: HIGH — Protected components are rendered regardless of authorization

details.conditionalRendering: PRESENT but incomplete — PermissionGate exists for action-level gating but route-level component rendering has no guards
details.permissionWrappers: PRESENT — PermissionProvider wraps AdminLayout but provides action-level, not route-level control
details.hiddenComponents: No route-level hidden component protection — All admin components render if route is accessed

protectedComponentValidation.recommendation: Create component-level route guards that check authorization before rendering. Register route-to-permission mappings and validate on every navigation.

lazyLoadingValidation.finding: All route components are lazily loaded with React.lazy() + Suspense

details.protectedLazyModules: Lazy modules are loaded but NOT guarded — module code is fetched regardless of authorization
details.unauthorizedLazyLoading: Possible — Module code is downloaded even for unauthorized users (no code-split protection)

lazyLoadingValidation.recommendation: Consider dynamic imports inside ProtectedRoute guard to prevent unauthorized code download.

details.refreshDuringNavigation: Works — React Router handles SPA refresh
details.logoutDuringRedirect: NOT TESTED — No concurrent navigation handling
details.expiredSessionDuringNavigation: PARTIAL — Session timers reset on activity but no route interception
details.interruptedNavigation: Not handled — No navigation interception on pending state
details.networkInterruption: Not handled — No offline route protection

stateRecoveryValidation.recommendation: Implement navigation guards that check session state before completing navigation. Add offline-aware routing.

details.navigationSync: Not implemented — Each tab has independent state
details.logoutSync: Not implemented — Logging out in one tab does not affect others
details.roleSync: Not implemented — Role changes in one tab do not propagate
details.sessionSync: Not implemented — Session expiry is per-tab memory
details.mechanism: sessionStorage is used for last_admin_page but no BroadcastChannel or storage event listeners exist

multiTabValidation.recommendation: Use BroadcastChannel API or storage event listeners to synchronize auth state, role changes, and logout across tabs.

details.desktop: Works — Full layout with sidebar navigation
details.tablet: Partial — Responsive layout exists but no tablet-specific route protection
details.mobile: Partial — Responsive layout exists but no mobile-specific route protection
details.navigationDrawer: Present — Sidebar with hamburger toggle on mobile
details.bottomNavigation: Not implemented — Desktop sidebar pattern used for all viewports
details.responsiveRedirects: Not implemented — No viewport-based route redirects

mobileValidation.recommendation: Add mobile-specific route protection considerations. Ensure navigation drawer properly hides protected routes on mobile.

accessibilityValidation.finding: Good accessibility foundations with skip-to-content and ARIA

details.keyboardNavigation: Command palette with Ctrl+K, skip-to-content link present
details.focusAfterRedirects: NOT verified — Focus management after route transitions not implemented
details.errorAnnouncements: Not implemented — No live region announcements for route errors

accessibilityValidation.recommendation: Add focus management after route transitions. Implement aria-live regions for route error announcements.

details.routeLoading: Lazy loading with Suspense — all routes are code-split
details.protectedRouteLatency: Not measured — No performance profiling done
details.redirectLatency: Not measured — React Navigation is client-side
details.navigationLatency: Not measured — Lazy loading adds slight delay on first access
